children: Norges Bank Investment Management, Norway's sovereign wealth fund manager, will vote against Monte dei Paschi's proposed bids to buy Banco BPM
The fund manager, which held a 2.98% stake in MPS at the end of December 2025, will also vote against the proposed merger of Italian merchant bank Mediobanca
into Monte dei Paschi, the sovereign wealth fund said on its website.
MPS investors meet on October 29 to vote on CEO Luigi Lovaglio's defence plan against a takeover offer by Intesa Sanpaolo
Norges will also vote against the proposed distribution of an extraordinary dividend from reserves
Its statement said it will instead approve the share buyback programme and the buyout of the shares Mediobanca holds in insurer Generali

Norges Bank Investment Management said its decisions were based on its voting principles according to which "mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions should maximise shareholder returns"
